info.name: Amazon DynamoDB Get Multiple Items from One or More Tables

items.docs: Returns the attributes of one or more items from one or more tables. You identify requested items by primary key. A single operation can retrieve up to 16 MB of data, which can contain as many as 100 items.

info.name: Amazon DynamoDB Put or Delete Multiple Items in One or More Tables

items.docs: Puts or deletes multiple items in one or more tables. A single call to BatchWriteItem can transmit up to 16 MB of data over the network, consisting of up to 25 put or delete requests.
